offering_description.value: Develops and sells prescription medicines for anemia and related complications of chronic kidney disease, mainly to dialysis providers and patients in the United States. It sells through its own sales force and specialty distribution, and partners sell its drugs in other countries.

primary_products.value: anemia treatment for chronic kidney disease; iron-based phosphate binder

customer_segment.value: B2B: dialysis organizations, nephrology practices, specialty pharmacies and wholesalers

revenue_model.value: product sales: prescription drugs sold to distributors, pharmacies and dialysis providers; licensing or royalties: license payments and royalties from partners selling its drugs outside the United States

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: develops and markets drugs made by contract manufacturers, sold to distributors and dialysis providers

geography_served.value: US national: United States, with dialysis providers and pharmacies nationwide, partners cover other countries

specialization.value: niche specialist: focused on kidney disease anemia and phosphate control medicines

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: own sales force calling on dialysis organizations and nephrologists; distributors / dealers: specialty drug distributors supplying pharmacies and dialysis clinics; partners / resellers: commercial partners selling its drugs in markets outside the United States
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: prescription drugs needing FDA approval and CMS reimbursement rules for dialysis-related drugs

notes: Partner territories and product portfolio details may have changed; treat partner and regional specifics as approximate.
